content.title: High Roller Technologies launches online casino brand in Finland
content.summary: High Roller Technologies (ROLR) announced the launch of Kassuuu, a new online casino brand developed specifically for the Finnish market. The brand’s name is drawn from Finnish slang: Kassu means casino, while KASSUUU! evokes the triumphant cheer of victory. This spirit is embodied in the Kassuuu Jackpot, a unique branded feature available on selected games, designed to amplify excitement while remaining clearly presented to players.
